title: Temperature
description: The temperature module displays the current temperature from a thermal zone.

placeholders.description: Icon, as selected from format-icons based on the current temperature.

hwmon-path.label: Hwmon path
hwmon-path.doc: The temperature path to use, e.g. /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon2/temp1_input instead of one in /sys/class/thermal/. This can also be an array of strings. In this case, waybar will check each item in the array and use the first valid one. This is suitable if you want to share the same configuration file among different machines with different hardware configurations.
hwmon-path.description: The temperature path to use, e.g. /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon2/temp1_input instead of one in /sys/class/thermal/. This can also be an array of strings. In this case, waybar will check each item in the array and use the first valid one. This is suitable if you want to share the same configuration file among different machines with different hardware configurations.

hwmon-path-abs.label: Hwmon path abs
hwmon-path-abs.doc: The path of the hwmon-directory of the device, e.g. /sys/devices/pci0000:00/0000:00:18.3/hwmon. (Note that the subdirectory hwmon/hwmon#, where # is a number is not part of the path!) Has to be used together with input-filename. This can also be an array of strings, for which, it just works like hwmon-path.
hwmon-path-abs.description: The path of the hwmon-directory of the device, e.g. /sys/devices/pci0000:00/0000:00:18.3/hwmon. (Note that the subdirectory hwmon/hwmon#, where # is a number is not part of the path!) Has to be used together with input-filename. This can also be an array of strings, for which, it just works like hwmon-path.

hwmon-name.label: Hwmon name
hwmon-name.doc: Select a hwmon device by its name (from /sys/class/hwmon//name), e.g. amdgpu. Requires input-filename to be set. Cannot be used together with hwmon-path or hwmon-path-abs*.
hwmon-name.description: Select a hwmon device by its name (from /sys/class/hwmon//name), e.g. amdgpu. Requires input-filename to be set. Cannot be used together with hwmon-path or hwmon-path-abs*.

input-filename.label: Input filename
input-filename.doc: The temperature filename of your hwmon-path-abs (also used by hwmon-by-name), e.g. temp1_input
input-filename.description: The temperature filename of your hwmon-path-abs (also used by hwmon-by-name), e.g. temp1_input

hwmon-by-name.label: Hwmon by name
hwmon-by-name.doc: The substring to search for in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmonX/name (where hwmonX is any folder in /sys/class/hwmon/). Waybar will search for every directory in /sys/class/hwmon/ and uses the directory in which the name matches hwmon-by-name.
hwmon-by-name.description: The substring to search for in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmonX/name (where hwmonX is any folder in /sys/class/hwmon/). Waybar will search for every directory in /sys/class/hwmon/ and uses the directory in which the name matches hwmon-by-name.

warning-threshold.label: Warning threshold
warning-threshold.doc: The threshold before it is considered warning (Celsius).
warning-threshold.description: The threshold before it is considered warning (Celsius).

critical-threshold.label: Critical threshold
critical-threshold.doc: The threshold before it is considered critical (Celsius).
critical-threshold.description: The threshold before it is considered critical (Celsius).

interval.label: Refresh every
interval.doc: The interval in which the information gets polled.
interval.description: How often the module updates its information.

disable-on-sleep.label: Disable on sleep
disable-on-sleep.doc: Pause polling while the bar is unmapped from its output, e.g. when the output is disabled or disconnected, and resume once the bar is mapped again. Turning an output off with DPMS does not necessarily unmap the bar: on Hyprland, for example, the bar stays mapped and polling continues while the display is powered off.
disable-on-sleep.description: Pause polling while the bar is unmapped from its output, e.g. when the output is disabled or disconnected, and resume once the bar is mapped again. Turning an output off with DPMS does not necessarily unmap the bar: on Hyprland, for example, the bar stays mapped and polling continues while the display is powered off.

format-warning.label: What to show when low
format-warning.doc: The format to use when temperature is considered warning
format-warning.description: The format to use when temperature is considered warning

format-critical.label: What to show when critical
format-critical.doc: The format to use when temperature is considered critical
format-critical.description: The format to use when temperature is considered critical

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format (Celsius/Fahrenheit/Kelvin) in which the temperature should be displayed.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

format-icons.label: Icons
format-icons.doc: Based on the current temperature (Celsius) and critical-threshold if available, the corresponding icon gets selected. The order is low to high.
format-icons.description: The icons used for {icon}. When it is a list, the first icon is used for the lowest level and the last one for the highest.

tooltip-format.label: Tooltip text
tooltip-format.description: What the popup shows. It uses the same placeholders as the bar text.

rotate.label: Rotation
rotate.doc: Positive value to rotate the text label (in 90 degree increments).
rotate.description: Rotate the text. Mostly useful on vertical bars.

max-length.label: Maximum length
max-length.doc: The maximum length in characters the module should display.
max-length.description: Cut the text when it is longer than this. Empty means no limit.

min-length.label: Minimum length
min-length.doc: The minimum length in characters the module should accept.
min-length.description: Keep the module at least this wide, so the bar doesn't jump around when the text changes.

align.label: Text position
align.doc: The alignment of the label within the module, where 0 is left-aligned and 1 is right-aligned. If the module is rotated, it will follow the flow of the text.
align.description: Where the text sits inside the module: 0 is left, 0.5 is center, 1 is right.

justify.label: Line alignment
justify.doc: The alignment of the text within the module's label, allowing options 'left', 'right', or 'center' to define the positioning.
justify.description: How lines are aligned when the text has more than one line.

on-click.label: Left click runs
on-click.doc: Command to execute when you click on the module.
on-click.description: A command to run when you click the module. Empty keeps the normal behavior.

on-click-middle.label: Middle click runs
on-click-middle.doc: Command to execute when middle-clicked on the module using mousewheel.
on-click-middle.description: A command to run when you click the module with the mouse wheel.

on-click-right.label: Right click runs
on-click-right.doc: Command to execute when you right-click on the module.
on-click-right.description: A command to run when you right-click the module.

on-update.label: On every refresh run
on-update.doc: Command to execute when the module is updated.
on-update.description: A command to run each time the module updates.

on-scroll-up.label: Scroll up runs
on-scroll-up.doc: Command to execute when scrolling up on the module.
on-scroll-up.description: A command to run when you scroll up over the module. It replaces what scrolling normally does.

on-scroll-down.label: Scroll down runs
on-scroll-down.doc: Command to execute when scrolling down on the module.
on-scroll-down.description: A command to run when you scroll down over the module. It replaces what scrolling normally does.

smooth-scrolling-threshold.label: Scroll sensitivity
smooth-scrolling-threshold.doc: Threshold to be used when scrolling.
smooth-scrolling-threshold.description: How far you must scroll on a touchpad before something happens. Higher means less sensitive.

tooltip.label: Show tooltip
tooltip.doc: Option to disable tooltip on hover.
tooltip.description: Show a small popup with more details when the mouse is over the module.

menu.label: Open popup menu with
menu.description: Which click opens a popup menu for this module.

menu-file.label: Menu layout file
menu-file.doc: Location of the menu descriptor file. There need to be an element of type GtkMenu with id menu
menu-file.description: The file that describes the menu entries (a GTK .xml file with a menu called "menu").

menu-actions.label: Menu commands
menu-actions.doc: The actions corresponding to the buttons of the menu.
menu-actions.description: For each menu entry, the command to run when you pick it.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.
